text:
Anna L: Quick UX: export button in trace panel says 'Export'. Propose 'Export traces' and show format (JSON/CSV) in modal. Thoughts?
Devin R: +1. Also ensure modal focus goes to format selector on open (not close X).
Micah P: Change 'Copy' action to 'Copy stack trace' and copy plain text by default (support pastes into tickets).
Liz C: Use label 'Trace ID' instead of 'Correlation ID'. Tooltip: 'Unique identifier for this request/trace'.
a11y-bot: Modal must trap focus and return focus to trigger. Add aria-live="polite" on success toast. Dropdown needs aria-label and arrow-key nav.
Devin R: Suggest toolbar placement: expose Export next to Share with chevron and a small pill showing last-used format.
Anna L: OK owners: Anna update Figma, Devin modal focus & aria-live, Micah server headers & sanitize copies, Liz final copy review, a11y-bot verify. Target: EOD Wed.
